messages:
sophia: Quick thread to lock the go-to-market plan for the HW+Marketplace private offer. Need SKU mapping, SI incentives, co-announce timing, and a clean renewal/fallback path. Can we do a short sync here?

ajay: TL;DR: customer wants 12-month commit w/ 2-month soft ramp. We need to translate that into marketplace-friendly fields. Don't want conditional text in the listing.

mike: Agree. My proposal: two explicit SKUs (ONRAMP + STEADY). ONRAMP maps months 1-2 pricing, STEADY maps months 3-12. That keeps the listing static. Example matrix below to map to ops: 
```
SKU: RWD-HW-ONRAMP-2024
Annualized commit buckets: 50k, 140k, 300k
Onramp discount: 28% (months 1-2) -> represented as ONRAMP SKU price
Steady discount: 14% (months 3-12) -> represented as STEADY SKU price
Monthly floor: 22% of annualized tier
Grace window: 30 days to cure shortfall
```

tara: SI incentive idea: split into (1) $9k onboarding credit (applies to invoice 1), and (2) $2.5k milestone payout after validation of deployment. Cap: first 3 deals per SI in the first 9 months. Credits are invoice-applied only.

sophia: Legal asked to avoid words like "penalty" and "overage" in external docs. Use "post-commit consumption adjustment". Also request that unused onboarding credits can optionally convert to a renewal credit if customer renews within 75 days and explicitly opts in.

ajay: Finance flagged currency exposure for APAC pilots. Proposal: list SKUs in USD but include a PO-level FX collar: +/-2.5% on renewal quotes only. Ops: is that acceptable to put in private-offer terms?

mike: Ops: marketplace listings can't include dynamic FX fields, but PO PDFs can. We'll keep listing static and add FX collar text in the private-offer agreement. Ops will confirm field limits in ticket.

tara: Marketing asks for a 9-business-day freeze on co-announcement copy before listing and 4 localized deck templates for field. Field also wants a sample 'worked example' of post-commit reconciliation to include in buyer comms.

sophia: On fallback pricing for under-delivery: suggested flow -> 30-day grace, attempt cure, then present two options to customer: (A) apply post-commit consumption adjustment at tier rate (presented as an adjustment, not a fee), or (B) convert to a lower tier pro-rated (no retroactive charge). The customer can choose within 15 days.

ajay: Add internal rule: if shortfall >20%, require AE+CS + RevOps review before automatic adjustment. That reduces churn risk.

mike: Marketplace ops question for ticket: can we attach two static price lines per private offer (onramp + steady) or do we need separate SKU IDs? I'll open the ticket with ops.

contracts-bot: create_draft: "Private Offer - HW Bundle Onramp/Steady PO". Draft ID: PO-D-5578. Assigned: contracts: tara, sophia. Due: 2024-06-12.

ajay: Action items:
- mike: open ops ticket with SKU mapping and confirm whether two price lines allowed by 2024-06-02
- tara: draft PO T&Cs including credit caps, renewal conversion mechanics, and FX collar language by 2024-06-05
- sophia: prepare buyer-facing worked example and renewal opt-in copy by 2024-06-06
- marketing: supply localized decks & co-announce templates by 2024-06-20

tara: One more legal note: onboarding credits must be non-transferable, expire after 9 months, and only apply to professional services invoices. I'll call out exact wording in PO-D-5578.

mike: Ops: I'll include an internal mapping doc so field can ship quotes that stitch ONRAMP+STEADY SKUs automatically. That solves the UX.

sophia: Thanks everyone. If no objections, I'll circulate the pilot brief with these action items and set a 1:1 with ops to finalize SKU naming conventions. :white_check_mark:
